summaryZh: iSTRIVE 实验室研究性别暴力、心理健康不良、物质滥用与 HIV 感染或传播等交织流行病。目标包括理解其免疫和生理联系、考察心理社会及性与生殖健康结局，并开发实施减少疾病与照护差距的干预。
researchQuestions: 性别暴力、不良心理健康、物质滥用与HIV感染及传播等交织流行问题，通过哪些免疫学与生理学机制相互联系？

evidence.quote: The mission of the iSTRIVE Research Lab is to conduct high-caliber research to investigate the combined epidemics—known as “syndemics”—of gender-based violence, adverse mental health, substance abuse, and HIV acquisition/transmission
advancing our understanding of the underlying immunological and physiological mechanisms linking these epidemics
developing and implementing interventions that provide maximal reductions in these syndemics while reducing disparities in prevention, care, and treatment.
